label: Realtor.com Scraper
title: Realtor.com Scraper: For Sale, Rentals, Sold & Risk Data
metaDescription: Scrape Realtor.com for sale, rent, sold and off-market homes by link, location or address: price history, taxes, schools, climate risk and agents.
intro: Search Realtor.com by link, location or address (for sale, for rent, sold or off market) and get prices, price history, taxes, schools, climate risk, market statistics, value estimates and agent and office contacts.
useCases: Pull comps with price history and taxes
Screen homes by school and climate risk

faq.a: No public one. This actor searches by link, location or address (for sale, for rent, sold or off market) and returns prices, price history, taxes and value estimates.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Realtor.com API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Realtor.com has no public API; its listing data comes from MLS feeds licensed to brokers and partners. This actor reads the public search and property pages on realtor.com.
